description: This file contains implementation of RSA blinding operations, including creation, update, conversion, and inversion of blinding factors, as well as related cryptographic setup functions.

classes.name: bn_blinding_st
classes.description: Structure representing RSA blinding factors, including Montgomery-encoded base and inverse values, and a counter for updates.

methods.name: bn_blinding_create_param
methods.description: Initializes the blinding parameters, generating random blinding factors and computing their Montgomery representations.
